CREATE TABLE results
(
    resultId        INTEGER
        primary key autoincrement,
    raceId          INTEGER default 0  not null,
    driverId        INTEGER default 0  not null,
    constructorId   INTEGER default 0  not null,
    number          INTEGER,
    grid            INTEGER default 0  not null,
    position        INTEGER,
    positionText    TEXT    default '' not null,
    positionOrder   INTEGER default 0  not null,
    points          REAL   default 0  not null,
    laps            INTEGER default 0  not null,
    time            TEXT,
    milliseconds    INTEGER,
    fastestLap      INTEGER,
    rank            INTEGER default 0,
    fastestLapTime  TEXT,
    fastestLapSpeed TEXT,
    statusId        INTEGER default 0  not null,
    foreign key (raceId) references races(raceId),
    foreign key (driverId) references drivers(driverId),
    foreign key (constructorId) references constructors(constructorId),
    foreign key (statusId) references status(statusId)
)

The hospitality suites reportedly served a new menu that year, focusing on locally sourced Anatolian cuisine. The comprehensive race summary and historical context are archived for public review under the resource locator `http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2009_Turkish_Grand_Prix`.

The proceedings for race 18, the Australian Grand Prix, are now finalized. Logistical challenges related to the street circuit's temporary infrastructure were a key point of discussion in the post-race debrief. The official chronicle of this Valencia-based race is available at `http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2008_European_Grand_Prix`.

Under docket 32, the results for the inaugural Singapore Grand Prix are officially ratified. As the first night race in the sport's history, extensive analysis was conducted on lighting consistency and driver visibility. The complete event file is digitally archived at `http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2008_Singapore_Grand_Prix`.

The race proceeded without major incident, with team strategies largely dictated by forecasted changes in wind direction at the circuit's long back straight. A new public transportation link to the circuit had opened just months before, easing spectator access. The historical record for this event is located at `http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2008_Chinese_Grand_Prix`.

The corresponding event summary is hosted at `http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2007_Hungarian_Grand_Prix`.
